parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { model: 'llama3', stream: false, format: 'json', messages: [{ role: 'system', content: 'You are a strict meeting classifier. Classify the meeting into exactly one of: Client Coaching, Internal Operations, Sales Discovery. Return only JSON with meeting_type, confidence_score (0 to 1), and summary. Do not invent facts.' }, { role: 'user', content: 'Classify this meeting using its title, participants and sampled transcript.\n' + JSON.stringify({ title: $json.title, participants: $json.participants, transcript: $json.sampled_transcript }) }] } }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO archived_sessions (
    session_id,
    meeting_type,
    confidence_score,
    summary,
    transcript,
    metadata,
    rejection_reason
)
VALUES (
    $1,
    $2,
    $3,
    $4,
    $5::jsonb,
    $6::jsonb,
    $7
)
ON CONFLICT (session_id)
DO UPDATE SET
    meeting_type = EXCLUDED.meeting_type,
    confidence_score = EXCLUDED.confidence_score,
    summary = EXCLUDED.summary,
    transcript = EXCLUDED.transcript,
    metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata,
    rejection_reason = EXCLUDED.rejection_reason;

options.queryReplacement: =={{ [  $json.session_id,  $json.classification.meeting_type,  $json.classification.confidence_score,  $json.classification.summary,  JSON.stringify($json.sampled_transcript),  JSON.stringify({    title: $json.title,    participants: $json.participants,    original_turn_count: $json.original_turn_count,    sampled_turn_count: $json.sampled_turn_count  }),  $json.firewall.reason] }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO knowledge_vault (
    session_id,
    stream_type,
    content,
    metadata,
    embedding
)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb, $5::vector)
ON CONFLICT (session_id, stream_type, content) DO NOTHING;
